The failure capture and tree show no visible tooltip after the hover timeout. The original driver did not record the actual pointer position or hit target.

The driver invoked the context command and moved the pointer immediately after the app callback, without waiting for the native context popup to disappear. This is a concrete unobserved transition, but the original artifact alone cannot prove it caused the missing tooltip.
The follow-up driver verifies popup disappearance and actual off-anchor-to-on-anchor OS input and hit identity; that candidate must establish its own native result.

Text excerpts, metadata, hashes and all nine original UIA artifact files are retained here, including the eight unchanged PNG captures. Full log and ZIP remain outside git and in the referenced Actions artifact.
